pages.text: [#](53341a)A Treefyd is a wooden guardian raised out of corrupted hedgecraft rather than bred.[#]()
pages.title: Treefyd

pages.text: [#](53341a)The witch prepares Treefyd Seeds, then plants them on living grass so the rooted thing may wake and walk.[#]()
[#](53341a)Two seeds from **Mutandis Extremis**, **Reek of Misfortune**, **Ember Moss**, **Artichoke**, **Mandrake Root**, and a **Tear of the Goddess**.[#]()
[#](53341a)Use the seed on the top of a grass block; it rises as your own guardian. Feeding an owned Treefyd another seed splits off a fresh one.[#]()
pages.title: Planting the Seed

pages.text: [#](53341a)A **Creeper Heart** hardens it, a **Demon Heart** more so, and a **Boline** toggles whether it wanders when idle.[#]()
[#](53341a)A filled **Taglock Kit** teaches it to ignore a named player or one creature.[#]()
